description: This Java interface defines a model for representing the status of a resource, such as a client connection or source/target device, within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity framework. It includes methods for retrieving resource type, client ID, address, status, status details, and the time since the resource entered the current state. Additionally, it contains nested enums and classes for resource type enumeration and JSON serialization schema.

classes.name: ResourceStatus.ResourceType
classes.description: Enumeration defining types of resources, such as source, target, client, or unknown.

classes.name: ResourceStatus.JsonFields
classes.description: Immutable class listing JSON field definitions for ResourceStatus serialization.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the type of the resource, e.g., source, target, or client.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns the client identifier associated with the resource.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Returns the address of the resource, if available.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current connectivity status of the resource.

methods.name: getStatusDetails
methods.description: Returns optional detailed information about the current status.

methods.name: getInStateSince
methods.description: Returns the timestamp since the resource has been in its current state.
